facts.en: Completed a visitor-services diploma at Fictional Pinecup Institute in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构松杯学院完成游客服务文凭课程。

facts.en: Held a paid seasonal reception role at Fictional Starling Hollow Campground from 2024-05 to 2024-09.
facts.zh: 2024-05 至 2024-09 在虚构椋鸟谷露营地担任有薪季节性接待员。

facts.en: Returned to the same seasonal role from 2025-05 to 2025-09; no employment at the campground is recorded between the seasons.
facts.zh: 2025-05 至 2025-09 返回同一季节性岗位；未记录两个季节之间在该露营地的雇佣经历。

facts.en: Checked arrivals against the warden’s pitch list and recorded tent size and booked nights.
facts.zh: 依据管理员的营位清单核对抵达情况，并记录帐篷尺寸及预订晚数。

facts.en: Assigned guests only to pitches marked available under the warden’s allocation rules.
facts.zh: 仅按管理员的分配规则，将宾客安排至标为可用的营位。

facts.en: Explained quiet hours, waste points and walking routes using the campground’s visitor map.
facts.zh: 使用露营地游客地图说明安静时段、废弃物投放点及步行路线。

facts.en: Logged complaints and contacted the on-duty warden for safety concerns or rule disputes.
facts.zh: 记录投诉，并就安全问题或规则争议联系当班管理员。

facts.en: Passed maintenance reports to the grounds team with pitch numbers and the time the issue was reported.
facts.zh: 向场地维护团队转交维修报告，附上营位编号及问题报告时间。

facts.en: Helped rewrite the arrival information card before the 2025 season.
facts.zh: 在 2025 年旺季开始前协助重写到场须知卡。

facts.en: Personally added a map key and a list of reception opening times; the warden checked site-rule wording.
facts.zh: 个人添加地图图例及接待处开放时间表；场地规则措辞由管理员核对。

facts.en: During a 2025-07 check, 17 of 20 sampled arrival envelopes contained the revised information card.
facts.zh: 2025-07 检查中，20 个抽样到场资料袋有 17 个包含修订版须知卡。

facts.en: Uses a paper pitch board, spreadsheet booking exports and a handheld payment terminal under the reception procedure.
facts.zh: 依据接待流程使用纸质营位板、电子表格预订导出文件及手持支付终端。

facts.en: Counted the reception float with the senior receptionist at shift handover; refunds required warden approval.
facts.zh: 轮班交接时与高级接待员共同清点备用金；退款须由管理员批准。

facts.en: Completed the campground’s internal evacuation-route orientation in 2024-05; it did not designate the candidate as an incident commander.
facts.zh: 2024-05 完成露营地内部疏散路线入门培训；该培训未指定候选人为事件指挥员。

facts.en: Volunteered on a weekend welcome table for Fictional Birchfeather Walking Club from 2022-06 to 2022-08.
facts.zh: 2022-06 至 2022-08 在虚构桦羽步行社的周末接待台做志愿者。

facts.en: At that club, counted returned route cards and checked whether participants had signed back in; walk leaders handled route decisions.
facts.zh: 在该社团清点交回路线卡，并检查参与者是否签回；路线决定由步行领队负责。

facts.en: Made a personal illustrated packing guide for a 2-night camping trip in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年为一次 2 晚露营制作个人图解打包指南。

facts.en: Enjoys observing cloud shapes and sketching them in a notebook.
facts.zh: 爱好观察云的形状并在笔记本中素描。

facts.en: Worked both Saturday and Sunday daytime reception shifts during the recorded seasons.
facts.zh: 在记录中的营业季节轮值过星期六及星期日的日间接待班。
